newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wong's Singapore spin-off placement taken.
newsitem.headline: Wong's Singapore spin-off placement taken.

text.p: Wong's Circuits (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday its 34.4 million initial public offer (IPO) placement shares had been fully taken up.

The company, a unit of Wong's International (Holdings) Ltd, launched an IPO on November 28 comprising the placement shares and 8.6 million shares offered to the public, all at a price of US$0.88 per share.
Wong's Circuits is a printed circuit board operation. The public offering closes December 10 and trading on the Stock Exchange of Singapore is due to begin on or around December 12.
